title: WC13: width-capped linear-merge collimation at x = 1/3 (parameter change of CW1/CW2) with T ~ 2^((19/6) sqrt n), S_C ~ 2^((1/3) sqrt n) and O(n) qubits

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single WC13 algorithm and configuration of proof.md (width cap w = ceil(sqrt(n)/3) on a linear-merge collimation tree, free-frequency odd-part decoder, controlled-shift 2-adic part, explicit source cap) outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including all failures, retries, discards and aborts, its total charged sequential work is T(N,s) = O(n^4 (log2 n)^2 2^((19/6) sqrt n)), with the uniform bit-length envelope B_T(n) = n^4 (log2 n)^2 2^((19/6) sqrt n), whose exact growth index is 1/2. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes. The inner coefficient is exact, not an unknown big-O constant. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single WC13 algorithm and configuration of proof.md (width cap w = ceil(sqrt(n)/3) on a linear-merge collimation tree, free-frequency odd-part decoder, controlled-shift 2-adic part, explicit source cap) outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including all failures, retries, discards and aborts, its peak classical workspace is S_C(N,s) = O(n^2 2^((1/3) sqrt n)) bits, with envelope B_C(n) = n^2 2^((1/3) sqrt n), whose exact growth index is 1/2. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes. The inner coefficient is exact, not an unknown big-O constant. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single WC13 algorithm and configuration of proof.md (width cap w = ceil(sqrt(n)/3) on a linear-merge collimation tree, free-frequency odd-part decoder, controlled-shift 2-adic part, explicit source cap) outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including all failures, retries, discards and aborts, its peak quantum workspace is S_Q(N,s) = O(n) qubits, with envelope B_Q(n) = n, whose exact growth index is 0. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes. The inner coefficient is exact, not an unknown big-O constant. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single WC13 algorithm and configuration of proof.md (width cap w = ceil(sqrt(n)/3) on a linear-merge collimation tree, free-frequency odd-part decoder, controlled-shift 2-adic part, explicit source cap) outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 from independent ideal coset copies, and on EVERY execution branch, including all failures, retries, discards and aborts, the total number Q(N,s) of fresh source copies acquired, counting every discarded, rejected and failed-attempt copy, is at most N(n+10) on the finite branch n < 64 and at most the precomputed cap Qcap = O(n^(3/2) (log2 n) 2^((19/6) sqrt n)) on the main branch n >= 64. Hence Q(N,s) = O(n^(3/2) (log2 n) 2^((19/6) sqrt n)), with envelope B_samples(n) = n^(3/2) (log2 n) 2^((19/6) sqrt n), whose exact growth index is 1/2. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes. The inner coefficient is exact, not an unknown big-O constant. This holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the tolerance claim for the same execution.

For the same WC13 algorithm and configuration in proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N >= 2 and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 > 2/3 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
